reason: FormatConfig gains an optional deck_size_origin (Registry|DraftSession) so a draft match's engine state round-trips; the origin is conferred only by the draft-match initializer (initialize_game / initialize_multiplayer_host_game's draft_session_min_deck_size) and ingress validation refuses a payload that already claims it, so older peers refuse such a state at decode. CardMetadata also gains an optional off_stack_mana_costs (a split card's per-half mana costs, CR 709.4b) carried in every DeckEntry face, so Jegantha's symbol check sees each half; it is omitted when empty, and an older peer ignores it and would still admit Jegantha with a repeating split card.
